plans.buy_case: AMZN is flashing a textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI 26.8 in oversold territory, price hugging the lower Bollinger Band (10th percentile), and MACD histogram turning up from a valley. The 200MA filter passes (price above it), and above-average volume suggests institutional accumulation into weakness.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip to 23–25 (stronger oversold confirmation) OR price to touch the lower BB support (~$235–236). Do not chase the current price; let the market come to you. Given your $3.2k portfolio, patience here costs nothing.
plans.exit_condition: Take 50% profit at RSI 60–65 (~$251–253); trail stop on remainder to 50MA or exit on break below 200MA ($232.51). If RSI climbs above 70 before hitting target, lock in gains—overbought often reverses fast in swing trades.
plans.risk: Earnings surprise, macro weakness (recession fears, rate shock), or failed mean reversion if AMZN breaks below 200MA with volume. At $3.2k portfolio, position sizing matters: risk no more than 2% (~$64) on this trade.
plans.notes: Quality company ✓, technicals aligned ✓, but the 'insufficient fundamental data' red flag is real. Before entering, verify: (1) latest earnings date & next earnings, (2) recent cash flow trends, (3) any cloud/AWS headwinds. A $3–4k portfolio should size this at ~$800–1200 max (3–5 shares at $235). The setup is solid, but don't rush; better entries come in the next 1–2 weeks.

plans.buy_case: SNPS is printing classic mean-reversion setup: RSI 29.5 (oversold), price kissing lower Bollinger Band, MACD histogram bottoming, all while respecting the 200MA filter. Technicals are textbook swing-long territory for a quality semiconductor/EDA name with healthy fundamentals.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to drop to 25–27 range OR price to touch the lower Bollinger Band (~$448). Confirm with a small uptick in MACD histogram (sign of momentum turn). Do NOT chase at current levels.
plans.exit_condition: Take half at 50MA resistance (~$475); trail stop on remainder to 20-day MA. Exit immediately if price breaks below 200MA ($462) on a daily close or if RSI spikes above 70 without new highs (divergence warning).
plans.risk: Lack of recent catalyst clarity is a real gap. If earnings disappoint or chip sector rolls over, oversold conditions can extend further before recovery. Tech volatility could trigger false breakouts. Position size accordingly (~$800–1,200 max for your portfolio).
